in_marathi.name: Sriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sriya is the name of the goddess Lakshmi, who represents wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is the consort of Vishnu and is often depicted with gold coins in her hands.
